welcome.title: Import your bank statement. Find recurring payments. Discover ways to save.
welcome.subtitle: Subscription Manager reads the statement you already have. It is not a bank and does not give financial advice.

preferences.title: Language, country and currency
preferences.subtitle: These three settings are independent. Changing one never changes the others.
preferences.countryHint: Used to read dates and amounts in your statements.
preferences.currencyHint: Used for your totals. Expenses in another currency are shown separately.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.noTrackers: No advertising SDK, no third-party behavioural analytics. Ever.
privacy.fileDeleted: Your statement file is deleted from our servers immediately after processing.
privacy.exportable: You can export or delete your account and all its data at any time.
privacy.accountRequired: An account is required to use the app. There is no guest mode.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Last step before your first import.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We will email you a reset link if an account exists.
forgotPassword.sent: If a matching account exists, a reset email has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: The link is valid once, and for a short time.
resetPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetPassword.done: Password updated. All your other sessions have been signed out.
resetPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new reset email.

chooseSource.title: Which file do you have?
chooseSource.csvDescription: Recommended. Exported from your bank in a few clicks, and read reliably.
chooseSource.pdfDescription: Works with PDF statements that have a readable structure. Always check the results before confirming.
chooseSource.pdfPlusRequired: PDF import is part of Plus beyond the free trial.

upload.title: Select your file
upload.hint: Maximum {{size}} MB. The file is deleted right after processing.
upload.pickerFailed: The file picker could not be opened. Check the app permissions and try again.

mapping.title: Match your columns
mapping.subtitle: We could not recognise the columns automatically. Tell us where each value is.

review.title: Check before importing
review.pdfNotice: Works with PDF statements that have a readable structure. Always check the results before confirming.

states.rollbackAvailable: You can still undo this import

dashboard.title: Dashboard

monthOverMonth.noComparison: No comparison available for last month

unconverted.title: Not included in these totals
unconverted.description: {{count}} expenses in {{currency}}. We never convert currencies without a verified exchange rate.

dashboard.priceAlertsPlus: Price increase alerts are part of Plus.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.description: Import a bank statement to see your recurring payments.

manual.editHint: Opens the correction form for this transaction.
manual.subtitle: For cash spending or anything your statement missed.
manual.secondaryNotice: Importing a statement stays the main route. Manual entry is only for corrections and what the statement missed.
manual.merchantHint: The name you want to see in your list.
manual.merchantOverrideHint: Leave empty to keep the label from your statement. The original is never overwritten.
manual.importedNotice: This line comes from an imported statement. Its original label is kept as is; your correction is stored separately.
manual.amountHint: For example 13.49 — up to two decimals.
manual.amountError: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals.
manual.dateError: Enter a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
manual.deleteConfirm: This deletes the transaction and any recurrence built on it. It cannot be undone.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.nextPaymentNotice: Estimated from your payment history — not a guarantee.

comparison.title: Compare
comparison.currentCost: Your current plan costs {{annual}} per year.
comparison.noSavings: This option is not cheaper than your current plan.
comparison.freshnessStale: Price not rechecked recently — shown for reference only
comparison.affiliateNotice: Affiliate link — we may earn a commission. This never affects the ranking.
comparison.refreshHint: Recomputes the match against verified offers. No price is collected automatically.

savings.title: Savings
savings.potentialHint: Found by comparing your subscriptions. Nothing is confirmed until you say so.
savings.confirmedHint: What you told us you actually saved.

goal.title: Savings goal
goal.noneHint: Set a target to track what your cancellations actually save you.
goal.createHint: The amount you want to save. You can change it later.
goal.confirmHint: Nothing is confirmed until you enter it here. Potential savings stay separate.

savings.scopeNotice: No transfers, no savings pot, no investment: this screen only tracks what you decided to save.

pricing.title: Free and Plus
pricing.subtitle: Prices are shown and charged by the app store.
pricing.storeNotice: Payment is handled by Google Play or the App Store. We never see or store your card details.

manage.title: Manage your subscription
manage.description: Subscriptions are managed by the store you bought them from.
manage.cancelNotice: If you cancel, you keep Plus until the end of the period you already paid for.
manage.androidPath: Google Play → Payments and subscriptions → Subscriptions
manage.noSubscription: You are on the Free plan. Nothing is billed.

purchase.title: Subscribe to Plus
purchase.verified: Purchase verified. Your plan has been updated.
purchase.serverNotice: The store charges you and issues a receipt. Your plan is granted only after our server verifies that receipt with the store.
purchase.unavailableHint: Everything else in the app works normally. Only the purchase itself needs a native build.

unavailable.NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE: In-app purchase is not available in Expo Go: it needs a development build.
unavailable.NOT_CONFIGURED: In-app purchase is not configured on this build.
unavailable.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: In-app purchase is not available on this platform.

failed.NO_OFFERING: This plan is not offered by the store right now.
failed.NO_PROOF: The store did not return a receipt. Nothing was charged to your account by us.
failed.STORE_ERROR: The store could not complete the purchase.
failed.TIMEOUT: The store did not answer in time. If you were charged, the purchase will be picked up the next time you open the app.

export.title: Export my data
export.description: You get a JSON file with your account, expenses, detections, savings goals and subscription status. It never contains passwords or security tokens.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.warning: This is irreversible. Your expenses, detections, savings goals and sessions are deleted permanently.
delete.blockedDescription: Your Plus subscription is still active. Cancel it and you can delete your account straight away — you do not have to wait until the end of the period you already paid for.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We process only what the app needs to work: your account, the expenses you import, and the detections computed from them.
privacy.noTrackers: No advertising SDK and no third-party behavioural analytics are embedded in this app.
privacy.files: Statement files are stored in a temporary folder, processed, and deleted immediately — including when processing fails.
privacy.rights: You can export all your data as JSON and delete your account at any time from Settings.
privacy.retention: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. Deleting your account deletes it permanently.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.service: Subscription Manager reads bank statements you provide to detect recurring payments and estimate their cost.
terms.notAdvice: The app is not a bank and does not provide financial, tax or investment advice. Figures are estimates based on the files you import.
terms.account: An account is required. You are responsible for keeping your password safe.
terms.billing: Paid plans are billed by Google Play or the App Store, under their own terms.
terms.termination: You can stop using the service and delete your account at any time.

cookies.title: Cookies and trackers
cookies.app: The mobile app uses no cookies. Your session is a token stored in the device secure storage.
cookies.noAds: There is no advertising SDK, no behavioural analytics SDK, and no advertising identifier in this app.
cookies.web: The public web pages use only what is strictly necessary to serve the page.

help.title: Help
help.importBody: CSV exports from your bank work best. PDF statements work when their structure is readable — always check the preview before confirming.
help.detectionBody: By comparing dates and amounts of payments to the same merchant. The rules are fixed and give the same result every time. You can always confirm, change or reject a detection.
help.currencyTitle: Why are some expenses excluded from my totals?
help.currencyBody: Because they are in another currency. We never convert without a verified exchange rate, so they are listed separately.
help.deleteTitle: How do I delete my account?
help.deleteBody: From Settings → Delete my account. If you have an active paid subscription, cancel it first.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Send us an email and we will get back to you.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.subtitle: Three fixed uses, built from figures already calculated by the app. No open chat, no free-text question.
